name: Beep Test (20m Multi-Stage Shuttle Run)
description: A maximal aerobic fitness test measuring progressive shuttle runs between two markers 20m apart at increasing speeds paced by audio beeps. VO₂ max estimated from level achieved.
reputation: Standard in sports team selection and military fitness; free protocols widely available.
notes: Requires outdoor/indoor space; audio pacing device needed; VO2max estimation has ~5% error.
